name: ai-job-search
description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
one_liner: A personal assistant that scans job listings, scores how well you match each one, and writes you a custom resume and cover letter for the ones worth applying to.
buyer: A job seeker (the creator built it after being laid off) who wants to send dozens of genuinely tailored applications a week instead of one generic resume everywhere.
business_use_cases: A career coach configures this for each client and charges a flat fee to run their weekly job-search pipeline for them.
A university career center runs it as a self-serve lab tool so students get tailored resumes without booking 1:1 appointments.
A bootcamp or outplacement firm packages a pre-configured version as a premium perk for members going through layoffs.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a done-for-you 'job search concierge' service: set this up for a client's profile and run it on their behalf every week.
Sell a one-time setup service for non-technical job seekers who can't install the Claude Code + LaTeX toolchain themselves.

steal_this: Fork it, swap in job boards for your own country, and offer the configured result as a weekend $50 setup-and-run service to a few job-hunting friends.
